auth.tagline: Nurturing your journey along with you.
auth.familyDoorSub: For pregnant women, mothers and caregivers
auth.notRegistered: This number isn't registered. Please ask your hospital.
auth.otpWrong: That code didn't match. Try again.
auth.chooseTitle: Which would you like to open?
auth.chooseSub: Your number is linked to both.
auth.network: Couldn't reach the hospital server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.expired: That code has expired. Tap “Resend code”.
auth.noAccess: This number has no access yet. Please ask your hospital.

family.bring: Bring your MCP card and reports
family.fasting: Sugar test: follow the food instructions on your lab slip
family.askCall: Ask the hospital to call me
family.emergencySub: Need help now? Call, or ask us to call you.
family.seeMoreOften: Your doctor wants to see you more often
family.missedUs: We missed you — please call to reschedule

status.discuss: Result ready — discuss at your visit

prep.bring: Bring your MCP card and reports
prep.fasting: Follow the food instructions on your lab slip

family.cantComeDone: We've told the hospital. They will call you to fix a new date.

cb.title: Ask the hospital to call you
cb.sub: Tick anything you noticed. Someone from the hospital will call you.
cb.voiceSoon: Voice notes arrive with the next build
cb.sentBody: The hospital will call you on {{phone}}.
cb.urgent: If it is urgent, don't wait — call 108 or the hospital now.
cb.cantCome: Can't come — wants a new date
cb.micBlocked: Microphone blocked — allow it in phone Settings, then try again.

log.title: Record a reading
log.sub: Your care team can see what you record here.
log.contractionsHint: Count them over the last hour
log.saved: Saved. Your care team can see this.
log.worried: Worried? Ask the hospital to call you.

signs.title: Warning signs
signs.banner: If you notice any of these, go to the hospital now or call 108.

card.title: My emergency card
card.sub: Show this to any doctor or ambulance. Anyone can scan it — you choose what's on it.
card.notShared: The emergency card is on {{name}}'s phone.

learn.englishOnly: Article text is in English for now.
learn.nothingNow: Nothing to read here right now. Your care team is here whenever you want to talk.

me.name: Name
me.neverSensitive: Private test results are never shared with family members.
me.canSeeChange: Tap a switch to change what they can see. It applies at once.
me.never: Test results are never shared with family members.

loss.title: Taking care of you
loss.body: We are here for you. Your check-ups continue below, and you can call us any time.

meds.title: My medicines
meds.note: Only medicines your doctor prescribed are shown. Your care team can see what you mark here.

rem.title: Visit reminders on this phone
rem.testDone: A test reminder will arrive in 10 seconds.
rem.notifBody: You have a hospital visit tomorrow.
rem.privacy: Reminders never show health details on your lock screen.
rem.denied: Notifications are off for this app. Allow them in phone Settings, then try again.
rem.unavailable: Reminders need the latest build of the app.

lock.title: App lock
lock.sub: Ask for fingerprint or phone PIN when the app opens — useful if others use this phone.
lock.lockedSub: Unlock to see your health information.
lock.none: Set a fingerprint or screen lock on this phone first.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.appointment: The hospital booked an appointment for you

consent.title: Your consent
consent.withdrawBody: The app will stop working for you and reminders will stop. Your hospital record stays with the hospital as required by law. You can give consent again when you next sign in.

guide.title: Newborn: day by day
guide.signs: When to go to the hospital

notShared.title: The baby's details are not shared with you

noAccess.title: No longer shared
noAccess.caregiver: {{name}} no longer shares her information with you. Please ask her if you think this is a mistake.

on.consent1: Your pregnancy and baby records stay with the hospital care team.
on.consent2: Only the care team sees your records. You choose what family can see.
on.consent3: We send visit and vaccine reminders how you choose — app, WhatsApp or SMS.
on.consent4: This app gives information only, not medical advice. Call 108 if worried.
on.consent5: You can ask the hospital to correct your details, and withdraw consent at any time.
on.detailsSub: If anything is wrong, tell your care team — they can correct it, including your mobile number.
on.channelsSub: You can change this later in Me.

signs.cord: Redness or pus at the cord

voice.noPermission: Allow the microphone to speak instead of typing.
voice.noLanguage: Voice typing isn't available in this language on this phone yet.

signOutUnsent.body_one: 1 change hasn't reached the hospital yet. Signing out deletes it.
